candidate.answerReason: Mary travels 2 kilometers in 40 minutes, or two-thirds of an hour, giving an average speed of 3 km/hr.

methods.label: Use the whole round trip
methods.explanation:
Average speed is total distance divided by total time. The same route is \(1\) km each way, so Mary's round-trip distance is \(2\) km. Her total walking time is
\[
30+10=40\text{ minutes}=\frac{40}{60}=\frac23\text{ hour}.
\]
Thus her average speed is
\[
\frac{2}{2/3}=3\text{ km/hr}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{3\text{ km/hr}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
methods.levelReason: The whole-trip distance-speed-time relationship and elementary time conversion give the answer directly.
